name: sci-ai-skill
title_zh: 从可溯源源面板拼出能过审的 Nature 风格图
tagline_zh: 在 Illustrator 2023 里分阶段搭建，每一步都有证据把关；改图时能说清每根线从哪来。
tagline_en: Stage-by-stage assembly in Illustrator 2023 with evidence-gated QA; every line traces to its source, so you can.
desc_en: Build editable, publication-ready scientific figures in Adobe Illustrator 2023 from traceable source panels, using Illustrator COM/MCP or visible Windows Computer Use, staged construction, and evidence-gated visual QA. Use when a user wants a Nature-style figure assembled or revised in Illustrator 2023.
why_zh: 不是一键生成，而是把「画图」拆成可复核的工序：源面板可溯源、视觉检查有门槛，改一处不会悄悄带偏整张图。
why_en: Not one-click magic—it breaks figure-making into auditable steps: traceable panels, gated visual checks, and no silent drift.
limit_zh: 只认 Illustrator 2023 的 COM/MCP 或可见 Windows 电脑操作。
limit_en: Requires Illustrator 2023 COM/MCP or visible Windows UI; source panels must pre-exist and be readable—no stats plotting from raw data; output is an.
title_en: Assemble Nature-style figures from traceable source panels
